site.name: Beacon Tools & Dashboards
site.tagline: Spotlight tools for focused, deep looks at selected targets, and live dashboards that track priority issues.

tools.name: X Account Spotlight
tools.blurb: X Account Spotlight collects and analyzes an X account’s posts to uncover activity patterns, interactions, recurring themes, and language worth closer review.

tools.name: Telegram Spotlight
tools.blurb: Telegram Spotlight collects channel posts by date and keyword, then maps connections and reveals patterns across conversations.

tools.name: Bluesky Spotlight
tools.blurb: Bluesky Spotlight downloads one account’s full public post history, then shows who that account interacts with, when it posts, and what it writes about.

tools.name: TikTok Spotlight
tools.blurb: TikTok Spotlight collects selected public TikTok posts, transcribes their audio, and uses AI to explore topics, mentions, view counts, and comment themes.

tools.name: Domain Recon
tools.blurb: Domain Recon does a deep dive into the registration details and technical infrastructure of a specific domain in order to surface hidden clues.

tools.name: Coordinated X Replies Spotlight
tools.blurb: Coordinated Replies Spotlight uncovers patterns of potential coordination by tracing repeat commenters, reply timing, shared narratives, and reused images across X threads.

tools.name: Crypto Spotlight
tools.blurb: Crypto Spotlight traces crypto wallet activity and fund flows to show how money moved.

tools.name: Paste Site Spotlight
tools.blurb: Paste Site Spotlight searches paste sites and leak sources, including GitHub and more with optional API keys, for an email, domain, username, or keyword, and shows a status for each source.

tools.name: Selector Spotlight
tools.blurb: Selector Spotlight searches a username across hundreds of sites, ranks hits as Verified, Likely, or manual check, and adds deep links plus an AI assessment.

tools.name: Email Header & Phishing Analyzer
tools.blurb: Email Header & Phishing Analyzer reads a pasted or uploaded email, traces the sending path, checks SPF, DKIM, and DMARC, and extracts IPs, domains, and URLs.

tools.name: Employee Vetting
tools.blurb: Employee Vetting checks job candidates and new hires from a LinkedIn profile or resume: identity and work history, online presence, news and court records, sanctions and watchlists, company ties, and discussion of the person on X and Telegram.

dashboards.name: China Diplomats on X
dashboards.blurb: Tracks about 230 X accounts run by China's foreign ministry, embassies, consulates and ambassadors: which messages spread across many accounts at once, who reposts whom, and how tone differs by country.

dashboards.name: Russia's Shadow Fleet
dashboards.blurb: Maps where about 720 tankers in Russia's shadow fleet go: port calls, loitering at sea, transponder gaps and radar detections from the last 90 days, with animated ship movements and a profile for every ship.

dashboards.name: Strategic World Brief
dashboards.blurb: Daily, cited brief that tracks 20 global storylines across security, politics, the economy and technology, with a story map, weekly synthesis and predictions log.

dashboards.name: Critical Minerals
dashboards.blurb: Tracks supply, prices, export controls and policy moves across the critical minerals that matter for defence and energy supply chains.

dashboards.name: Ukraine Money Flows
dashboards.blurb: Follows aid, financing and funding flows to and around Ukraine, with sources for each figure.

dashboards.name: Latin America Cartel Dashboard
dashboards.blurb: Maps cartel territory, violence, leaders, money flows and seizures across Latin America, with a live X feed and sourced timelines.

dashboards.name: Axis Channel Network
dashboards.blurb: Findings map of how messages, websites and fundraising details move between Iran-aligned groups’ public Telegram, Eitaa and X channels, 20 Sep – 20 Oct 2026.

dashboards.name: Belt and Road
dashboards.blurb: Map of 32 Chinese-backed ports, railways, mines, bases and loans across Africa, South Asia and Southeast Asia, with what China gets, the host country's case, confidence and sources.

dashboards.name: Africa Brief
dashboards.blurb: Sourced map of conflicts in Africa: who backs whom, the resources at stake, money flows and China's Belt and Road projects, with region explainers and translated local news.

dashboards.name: Jihadist Groups
dashboards.blurb: Who's who of 45 jihadist groups in four families: a map, who leads each group, links between groups, the last 30 days of major incidents and the momentum of each group.
